$comment: Direction: Swift to Rust. Protocol 38. Local IPC only. The question after a block (work_block_state.rating_prompt) was drawn on screen. A fact, never an answer: the payload has one field and no place an answer could be carried. The service stamps it on arrival and keeps the first sighting; a second report, or one for a question that has expired or was answered, changes nothing. Answered with nothing, so a re-render cannot provoke another report.
